worldStories.originalTitle: ‘Out of control’ killings in Spanberger’s Virginia reach ‘insane’ point as migrant charged in stabbing spree
worldStories.snippet: Virginia Democratic Gov. Abigail Spanberger faces backlash as ICE lodges a detainer on an illegal immigrant charged with murder in a stabbing spree.
worldStories.fullContent:
Anger is boiling over at Virginia Democratic Gov. Abigail Spanberger and sanctuary-friendly politicians over "out of control" killings in the state after U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) asked the state not to allow the release of yet another illegal immigrant charged with carrying out a stabbing spree.

ICE sent a request to Spanberger and "her fellow sanctuary politicians " not to release Mexican illegal immigrant Freddi Chigo Mil following his arrest for allegedly stabbing two women on the streets of Staunton, Virginia, according to the Department of Homeland Security. Police responding to the incident found Mil at the scene along with two stabbed women, one of whom was pronounced dead while the other was transported to a local hospital.

Mil is charged with second-degree murder and aggravated malicious wounding causing permanent impairment, according to Middle River Regional Jail records. The same day, ICE arrested Salvadoran illegal immigrant Yinmi Molina-Zepeda in Woodbridge, Virginia, after it was discovered that he is wanted in his home country for aggravated homicide and other crimes.

Commenting on the growing list of illegal immigrants accused of violent crimes in Virginia, Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin remarked that "this is what the Commonwealth of Virginia has become under the sanctuary policies of Gov. Abigail Spanberger and her fellow sanctuary politicians."

'ALIEN HARBORING' ACCUSATIONS FLY AS DC-AREA COUNTY SPENDS TAXPAYER FUNDS TO BLUNT ICE

Regarding Mil, Mullin said, "this illegal alien from Mexico has been charged with murder after a stabbing spree that killed one woman and injured another."

He explained that " ICE has lodged a detainer asking Gov. Spanberger to cooperate with us and commit to not releasing this criminal from jail, so that he can be removed from our country once he faces justice."

"It’s time to put an end to these preventable tragedies," he continued, adding, "Deporting illegal aliens saves lives."

Jennifer Harrison, executive director of the victim advocacy organization Victims' Rights Reform Council, told Fox News Digital that "everything is out of control in these upside-down jurisdictions run by politicians like Spanberger who call themselves ‘moderate Democrats’ while implementing policies that put criminals ahead of victims and public safety."

Harrison posed the question: "How much blood has to be spilled in our streets before elected officials wake up and change course?"

"We have reached a point where the federal government has to ask state and local officials not to release dangerous illegal immigrants back into American communities. Think about how insane that is," Harrison continued.

"These are people who should not be in this country to begin with, and yet after they are accused of committing serious crimes here, when they have dead bodies in front of them, we are still having a debate over whether they should be released back onto our streets."

SPANBERGER'S ICE RESTRICTIONS DEALT MAJOR SETBACK AS JUDGE WARNS OTHER BLUE STATES

In a news release, DHS pointed to 22 cases of violent crime involving illegal immigrants in Virginia this year. Charges filed against illegal immigrants in Virginia this year include child pornography offenses, sex offenses against children, attempted disarming of a law enforcement officer, murder, aggravated sexual battery, rape, abduction and other serious crimes.

A spokesperson for Spanberger's office responded by telling Fox News Digital that the governor "strongly believes violent criminals who are in the United States illegally should be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law and deported."

The spokesperson said that "under Gov. Spanberger’s leadership, the Virginia Department of Corrections continues the long-standing practice of notifying ICE when individuals born outside of the United States are in state custody" and that "Virginia state law enforcement agencies also continue to participate in task forces and interagency cooperation with federal agencies."

They added that "As a former federal law enforcement officer who went after child predators, Gov. Spanberger will always prioritize the safety and well-being of Virginia families."

Fox News Digital also reached out to the Middle River Regional Jail for comment.

Sean Kennedy, president of Virginians for Safe Communities, told Fox News Digital, "Spanberger's actions are not pro-immigrant . They are pro-criminal."

"By shielding dangerous offenders from removal precisely because they are foreign nationals, she is loosing predators onto our streets. In fact, these predators overwhelmingly prey on other innocent immigrants, the ones she claims to be helping," said Kennedy.

WATCH: 'LIFELONG DEMOCRAT' ADMITS SHE IS ‘ASHAMED’ OF PARTY AFTER SON KILLED IN ILLEGAL IMMIGRANT CRASH

He accused Spanberger of shielding illegal immigrant criminals from consequences "by blocking ICE at every turn," saying, "Victims' faces should haunt the governor when she looks in the mirror."

"Every murder, rape, and robbery by an illegal alien was preventable if they had never been allowed in and let stay here," he emphasized, concluding, "They didn't have to die. She only had to follow the law, not her agenda."
worldStories.fullTranslation:
在美国移民与海关执法局（ICE）请求弗吉尼亚州切勿释放又一名被控实施连环持刀伤人案的非法移民后，针对该州民主党籍州长阿比盖尔·斯潘伯格（Abigail Spanberger）及庇护友好型政客在全州范围内“失控”杀戮事件的愤怒情绪正在彻底爆发。

据美国国土安全部透露，在墨西哥籍非法移民弗雷迪·奇戈·米尔（Freddi Chigo Mil）因涉嫌在弗吉尼亚州斯汤顿街头刺伤两名女性而被捕后，ICE已向斯潘伯格及“其同僚庇护政客”发出请求，要求不得释放该嫌疑人。警方赶赴案发现场后，发现了米尔以及两名被刺伤的女性，其中一人当场被宣告死亡，另一人则被送往当地医院救治。

根据米德尔河区域监狱（Middle River Regional Jail）的记录，米尔被控二级谋杀罪以及导致永久性残疾的加重恶意伤人罪。就在同一天，ICE在弗吉尼亚州伍德布里奇逮捕了萨尔瓦多籍非法移民尹米·莫利纳-泽佩达（Yinmi Molina-Zepeda），此前当局发现他在其祖国因加重杀人罪及其他罪行而被通缉。

国土安全部长马克韦恩·穆林（Markwayne Mullin）在谈及弗吉尼亚州被控暴力犯罪的非法移民名单不断增加时指出：“这就是弗吉尼亚联邦在州长阿比盖尔·斯潘伯格及其同僚庇护政客推行的庇护政策下沦落成的模样。”

华盛顿特区周边县动用纳税人资金削弱ICE执法引发“窝藏非法外国人”指控

谈及米尔一案，穆林表示：“这名来自墨西哥的非法外国人因在一场致一死一伤的连环刺伤事件中被指控犯有谋杀罪。”

他解释道：“ICE已发出一份拘留令，要求斯潘伯格州长与我们配合，并承诺不会从监狱释放这名罪犯，以便在他接受法律审判后能够被驱逐出境。”

“是时候终结这些原本可以预防的悲剧了，”他继续说道，并补充称：“驱逐非法外国人能够拯救生命。”

受害者权益倡导组织“受害者权利改革委员会”（Victims' Rights Reform Council）执行主任珍妮弗·哈里森（Jennifer Harrison）向福克斯新闻数字频道表示：“在这些颠倒黑白的司法管辖区里，一切都失控了。这些地方由像斯潘伯格这样自称为‘温和派民主党人’的政客掌管，他们推行的政策把罪犯置于受害者和公共安全之上。”

哈里森提出了这样的质问：“在民选官员清醒过来并改弦易辙之前，我们的街头还要流多少血？”

哈里森接着说：“我们已经到了这样一个地步：联邦政府不得不恳求州和地方官员不要将危险的非法移民放回美国社区。想想这有多么疯狂吧。”

“这些人原本从一开始就不应该在这个国家，然而在他们在这里被指控犯下重罪、眼前躺着死者遗体之后，我们竟然还在争论是否应该将他们放回我们的街头。”

法官警告其他蓝州之际，斯潘伯格限制ICE执法的举措遭遇重大挫折

在发布的新闻通报中，国土安全部指出了弗吉尼亚州今年发生的22起涉及非法移民的暴力犯罪案件。今年弗吉尼亚州对非法移民提起的指控包括儿童色情犯罪、针对儿童的性犯罪、企图解除执法人员武装、谋杀、加重性侵犯、强奸、绑架以及其他严重罪行。

斯潘伯格办公室的一名发言人在回应福克斯新闻数字频道时表示，州长“坚信在美国境内的非法暴力罪犯应当受到法律的最大限度起诉并被驱逐出境”。

该发言人称：“在斯潘伯格州长的领导下，弗吉尼亚州惩教部继续维持长期以来的做法，即在非美国本土出生的人员被州拘留期间通知ICE”，并且“弗吉尼亚州执法机构也继续参与特别工作组，并与联邦机构开展跨部门合作”。

他们还补充说：“作为一名前联邦执法官员，曾致力于打击侵害儿童的捕食者，斯潘伯格州长将始终把弗吉尼亚州家庭的安全与福祉放在首位。”

福克斯新闻数字频道也就此事联系了米德尔河区域监狱以寻求评论。

“弗吉尼亚人为了安全社区”组织（Virginians for Safe Communities）主席肖恩·肯尼迪（Sean Kennedy）向福克斯新闻数字频道表示：“斯潘伯格的所作所为并不是支持移民，而是纵容犯罪。”

肯尼迪说：“恰恰因为他们是外国公民而庇护危险罪犯免遭遣返，她是在把掠食者放虎归山到我们的街头。事实上，这些掠食者绝大多数都在残害其他无辜的移民——正是她声称要帮助的那些人。”

观看：“终身民主党人”在儿子死于非法移民车祸后承认对该党“感到羞耻”

他指责斯潘伯格“处处阻挠ICE执法”，从而包庇非法移民罪犯免受惩处，并称：“当这位州长照镜子时，受害者的面孔应该在她心中久久挥之不去。”

“如果非法外国人从一开始就未被允许入境并获准留在这里，那么他们所犯下的每一起谋杀、强奸和抢劫案原本都是可以避免的，”他强调道，并总结称：“他们本不必死。她只需要遵守法律，而不是贯彻她自己的政治议程。”

financeStories.title: 大陆资源公司与委内瑞拉国家石油公司达成石油协议
financeStories.originalTitle: Continental Strikes Venezuela Oil Deal with PDVSA
financeStories.snippet: Continental Resources signed a memorandum of understanding with Venezuela's state oil company PDVSA on Wednesday to operate and develop the Ayacucho 2 Block in the Orinoco Belt, the company announced, with an estimated 30 billion barrels of resource in place across roughly 126,000 acres in Anzoátegui state. financeStories.fullContent: Continental Resources signed a memorandum of understanding with Venezuela's state oil company PDVSA on Wednesday to operate and develop the Ayacucho 2 Block in the Orinoco Belt, the company announced, with an estimated 30 billion barrels of resource in place across roughly 126,000 acres in Anzoátegui state.  The two sides intend to advance a long-term Contrato de Participación Productiva agreement in the coming weeks; once it's signed, Continental will operate the block with a 100% working interest. The deal is one in a flurry of deals following the Trump administration's call for American energy companies to help rebuild Venezuela's oil industry. CEO Doug Lawler called Ayacucho 2 "one of the most significant resource opportunities in Continental's nearly 60-year history," and Founder and Chairman Emeritus Harold Hamm said the agreement takes the company "to an entirely new level." Continental's deal comes shortly after Chevron's September 2 commitment of more than $7 billion over five years to roughly double its own Orinoco Belt output to 600,000 barrels a day, days after the Trump administration announced a 25-year deal targeting 1.5 million barrels a day across 17 Venezuelan oilfields. Venezuelan Vice President Delcy Rodriguez said that the deal could generate more than $200 billion, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio putting near-term private investment at nearly $100 billion. Venezuela holds the world's largest proven crude reserves, but produced just 0.8% of global crude output that year, 742,000 barrels a day, a 70% decline from 2013 levels. Extracting the country's mostly extra-heavy Orinoco crude requires technical expertise international oil companies possess but have been largely barred from deploying under years of U.S. sanctions. Continental is the world's largest privately held oil and gas producer and it holds core U.S. positions in the Bakken, Anadarko, Powder River and Permian basins, also recently expanding into Argentina's Vaca Muerta shale and a joint venture in Turkey's Diyarbakr Basin. Ayacucho 2 is its first foray into Venezuela. Also on Wednesday, Turkish firm Çan2 Termik's subsidiary Minerosol Group signed a separate 20-year agreement with PDVSA, taking over production at the CEMA field in Anzoátegui state under a $381.7 million investment plan. The field holds 104.2 million barrels of remaining oil reserves and 499.3 billion cubic feet of gas across 10 fields. Current output of about 400 barrels a day is targeted to rise to 9,865 barrels a day.  By Charles Kennedy for Oilprice.com
financeStories.fullTranslation: 大陆资源公司周三宣布，已与委内瑞拉国营石油公司PDVSA签署谅解备忘录，将运营并开发奥里诺科带的阿亚库乔2区块。该区块位于安索阿特吉州，占地约12.6万英亩，预计原地资源量达300亿桶。双方计划在未来几周推进签署一项长期的生产参与合同（Contrato de Participación Productiva）；合同签署后，大陆资源公司将以100%的工作权益运营该区块。此次协议是特朗普政府呼吁美国能源企业帮助重建委内瑞拉石油产业后达成的一系列协议之一。首席执行官道格·劳勒称，阿亚库乔2区块是“大陆资源公司近60年历史上最重要的资源机遇之一”；公司创始人兼名誉董事长哈罗德·哈姆则表示，这项协议将公司“带到一个全新的层面”。大陆资源公司的协议签署前不久，雪佛龙于9月2日承诺在五年内投入逾70亿美元，计划将其在奥里诺科带的日产量大致翻番至60万桶。几天前，特朗普政府宣布达成一项为期25年的协议，目标是使委内瑞拉17个油田的日产量达到150万桶。委内瑞拉副总统德尔西·罗德里格斯表示，该协议可能创造超过2000亿美元的收益；美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥则称，近期私人投资规模接近1000亿美元。委内瑞拉拥有全球最大的已探明原油储量，但当年原油产量仅占全球总产量的0.8%，为日产74.2万桶，较2013年水平下降70%。开采该国以奥里诺科地区超重质原油为主的资源，需要国际石油公司所具备的技术专长，但在美国多年制裁下，这些公司一直基本无法在当地开展相关业务。大陆资源公司是全球最大的私人持有石油和天然气生产商，在美国巴肯、阿纳达科、粉河和二叠纪盆地拥有核心资产；近期还拓展至阿根廷瓦卡穆埃尔塔页岩区，并在土耳其迪亚尔巴克尔盆地参与一项合资项目。阿亚库乔2区块是该公司首次进军委内瑞拉。同样在周三，土耳其企业Çan2 Termik旗下子公司Minerosol Group与PDVSA签署了另一项为期20年的协议。根据一项3.817亿美元的投资计划，该公司将接管安索阿特吉州CEMA油田的生产。该油田分布于10个区块，拥有1.042亿桶剩余石油储量和4993亿立方英尺天然气储量。目前约为日产400桶的产量，目标提高至日产9865桶。

financeStories.originalTitle: After accusations of selling ‘perv glasses,’ Meta prepares to sell a pair without a camera
financeStories.snippet: Can Meta dodge the "pervert glasses" accusations with a new camera-free product?
financeStories.fullContent:
Meta’s camera-equipped smart glasses have proven more successful than other entrants into the market, but they have also deeply disturbed certain consumers who see them as invasive emblems of a dystopian surveillance society run amok. Now, as the company weathers complaints that it’s selling “pervert glasses,” it has reportedly decided to sell a pair that doesn’t come with integrated spy equipment.

The Information reports that Meta has developed a new smart glasses model, dubbed Luna, that, sans cameras, comes equipped with a convenient system to communicate with the company’s AI chatbot and Muse, its AI consumer agent. The glasses include six built-in microphones so users can communicate with the chatbot, as well as a button on the side of the glasses that, when pressed, activates the AI system.

Luna may be unveiled as soon as Meta Connect, the outlet notes; the event takes place next week.

TechCrunch reached out to Meta for more information.

The smart glasses industry has grown over the past few years, with Meta positioned near the front of the pack of providers. However, concerns over usability, cost, and privacy have dogged the business, with many consumers still unsure of how, why, or if they should use the devices. Meta’s Reality Labs, which is responsible for developing its smart glasses line, is still losing a gargantuan amount of money, its earnings report from April revealed.

financeStories.title: X现在将允许美国用户通过Cashtags进行交易
financeStories.originalTitle: X will now let US users trade via Cashtags
financeStories.snippet: The move closes the gap between the market discussions taking place on the timeline, and the market itself.
financeStories.fullContent:
X will now allow users to trade from their timelines. The Elon Musk-owned social network on Wednesday launched a feature called Cashtag that will let U.S. users on X place stock trades via participating brokerages. Initial partners on the effort include Interactive Brokers, Moomoo, Gemini, Kraken, and Coinbase.

The move takes advantage of what users on X have been doing for years: talking about stocks and, in more recent years, crypto. In 2008, the financial platform StockTwits even came up with the idea for X-precursor Twitter’s Cashtags, which placed a dollar sign ($) in front of stock ticker symbols to make market conversations easy to find and reference.

However, those Cashtags were about tracking the conversations around a particular stock, not actually trading them. Now that X has moved into the financial space with X Money, that’s changed.

Now, Cashtags, which turn ticker symbols for stocks, ETFs, and cryptocurrencies, will give X users the option to trade stocks.

“Cashtags close the gap between a ticker on the timeline and the market itself. When you post or tap a ticker, you’re taken right to the asset, where you have seamless access to the live chart, the conversation around it, and now the ability to trade with one of our brokerage partners,” said Mridul Singhai, X Product Engineering Lead, in a statement shared with TechCrunch.

“With our Cashtag partners, we’re connecting the financial conversation to action. People come to X to discover what’s happening, shape the conversation, and act in real-time on what matters to them,” Monique Pintarelli, SpaceXAI’s Head of Global Advertising, said in a statement. “Our Cashtag partners make it possible to move seamlessly from discovery and conversation to a brokerage, without breaking the moment.”

However, the feature could spur more market manipulation by the way of AI-controlled bots, spammers, and other bad actors, who could attempt to shift the conversation in one direction or another. But one could argue that this is already happening on X today, even without the direct connection to brokerages.

X现在将允许用户直接在时间线上进行交易。这家由埃隆·马斯克持有的社交网络周三推出了一项名为Cashtag的功能，允许X平台上的美国用户通过参与合作的券商下达股票交易指令。该项目的初始合作伙伴包括盈透证券（Interactive Brokers）、Moomoo、Gemini、Kraken和Coinbase。

这一举措利用了X用户多年来一直在做的事情：讨论股票，以及近些年来讨论加密货币。2008年，金融平台StockTwits甚至提出了X前身Twitter的Cashtags概念，即在股票代码前加上美元符号（$），以便人们更容易找到和引用市场讨论。

不过，这些Cashtags此前只是用于追踪围绕某只股票展开的讨论，并不能真正交易相关股票。如今，随着X通过X Money进军金融领域，情况发生了变化。

现在，Cashtags会识别股票、交易所交易基金（ETF）和加密货币的代码，并为X用户提供交易股票的选项。

X产品工程负责人Mridul Singhai在与TechCrunch分享的一份声明中表示：“Cashtags弥合了时间线上的代码与市场本身之间的差距。当你发布或点击某个代码时，系统会直接将你带到相关资产页面，在那里你可以无缝查看实时图表、围绕该资产的讨论，以及现在通过我们的某家券商合作伙伴进行交易的能力。”

SpaceXAI全球广告负责人Monique Pintarelli在一份声明中表示：“通过Cashtag合作伙伴，我们正在把金融讨论与行动连接起来。人们来到X，是为了发现正在发生的事情、塑造讨论，并实时对他们关心的事情采取行动。我们的Cashtag合作伙伴让用户能够从发现和讨论无缝转到券商，而不会打断这一时刻。”

不过，这项功能可能会因人工智能控制的机器人、垃圾信息发送者和其他不良行为者而助长更多市场操纵行为。这些人可能试图将讨论引向某个方向。但也有人可以认为，即使没有与券商的直接连接，这种情况如今已经在X上发生了。

financeStories.title: 斯潘伯格治下的弗吉尼亚州“失控”杀戮达“疯狂”地步，一非法移民因连环持刀伤人案被起诉
financeStories.originalTitle: ‘Out of control’ killings in Spanberger’s Virginia reach ‘insane’ point as migrant charged in stabbing spree
financeStories.snippet: Virginia Democratic Gov. Abigail Spanberger faces backlash as ICE lodges a detainer on an illegal immigrant charged with murder in a stabbing spree.
financeStories.fullContent:
Anger is boiling over at Virginia Democratic Gov. Abigail Spanberger and sanctuary-friendly politicians over "out of control" killings in the state after U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) asked the state not to allow the release of yet another illegal immigrant charged with carrying out a stabbing spree.

ICE sent a request to Spanberger and "her fellow sanctuary politicians " not to release Mexican illegal immigrant Freddi Chigo Mil following his arrest for allegedly stabbing two women on the streets of Staunton, Virginia, according to the Department of Homeland Security. Police responding to the incident found Mil at the scene along with two stabbed women, one of whom was pronounced dead while the other was transported to a local hospital.

Mil is charged with second-degree murder and aggravated malicious wounding causing permanent impairment, according to Middle River Regional Jail records. The same day, ICE arrested Salvadoran illegal immigrant Yinmi Molina-Zepeda in Woodbridge, Virginia, after it was discovered that he is wanted in his home country for aggravated homicide and other crimes.

Commenting on the growing list of illegal immigrants accused of violent crimes in Virginia, Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin remarked that "this is what the Commonwealth of Virginia has become under the sanctuary policies of Gov. Abigail Spanberger and her fellow sanctuary politicians."

'ALIEN HARBORING' ACCUSATIONS FLY AS DC-AREA COUNTY SPENDS TAXPAYER FUNDS TO BLUNT ICE

Regarding Mil, Mullin said, "this illegal alien from Mexico has been charged with murder after a stabbing spree that killed one woman and injured another."

He explained that " ICE has lodged a detainer asking Gov. Spanberger to cooperate with us and commit to not releasing this criminal from jail, so that he can be removed from our country once he faces justice."

"It’s time to put an end to these preventable tragedies," he continued, adding, "Deporting illegal aliens saves lives."

Jennifer Harrison, executive director of the victim advocacy organization Victims' Rights Reform Council, told Fox News Digital that "everything is out of control in these upside-down jurisdictions run by politicians like Spanberger who call themselves ‘moderate Democrats’ while implementing policies that put criminals ahead of victims and public safety."

Harrison posed the question: "How much blood has to be spilled in our streets before elected officials wake up and change course?"

"We have reached a point where the federal government has to ask state and local officials not to release dangerous illegal immigrants back into American communities. Think about how insane that is," Harrison continued.

"These are people who should not be in this country to begin with, and yet after they are accused of committing serious crimes here, when they have dead bodies in front of them, we are still having a debate over whether they should be released back onto our streets."

SPANBERGER'S ICE RESTRICTIONS DEALT MAJOR SETBACK AS JUDGE WARNS OTHER BLUE STATES

In a news release, DHS pointed to 22 cases of violent crime involving illegal immigrants in Virginia this year. Charges filed against illegal immigrants in Virginia this year include child pornography offenses, sex offenses against children, attempted disarming of a law enforcement officer, murder, aggravated sexual battery, rape, abduction and other serious crimes.

A spokesperson for Spanberger's office responded by telling Fox News Digital that the governor "strongly believes violent criminals who are in the United States illegally should be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law and deported."

The spokesperson said that "under Gov. Spanberger’s leadership, the Virginia Department of Corrections continues the long-standing practice of notifying ICE when individuals born outside of the United States are in state custody" and that "Virginia state law enforcement agencies also continue to participate in task forces and interagency cooperation with federal agencies."

They added that "As a former federal law enforcement officer who went after child predators, Gov. Spanberger will always prioritize the safety and well-being of Virginia families."

Fox News Digital also reached out to the Middle River Regional Jail for comment.

Sean Kennedy, president of Virginians for Safe Communities, told Fox News Digital, "Spanberger's actions are not pro-immigrant . They are pro-criminal."

"By shielding dangerous offenders from removal precisely because they are foreign nationals, she is loosing predators onto our streets. In fact, these predators overwhelmingly prey on other innocent immigrants, the ones she claims to be helping," said Kennedy.

WATCH: 'LIFELONG DEMOCRAT' ADMITS SHE IS ‘ASHAMED’ OF PARTY AFTER SON KILLED IN ILLEGAL IMMIGRANT CRASH

He accused Spanberger of shielding illegal immigrant criminals from consequences "by blocking ICE at every turn," saying, "Victims' faces should haunt the governor when she looks in the mirror."

"Every murder, rape, and robbery by an illegal alien was preventable if they had never been allowed in and let stay here," he emphasized, concluding, "They didn't have to die. She only had to follow the law, not her agenda."

在美国移民与海关执法局（ICE）请求弗吉尼亚州切勿释放又一名被控实施连环持刀伤人案的非法移民后，针对该州民主党籍州长阿比盖尔·斯潘伯格（Abigail Spanberger）及庇护友好型政客在全州范围内“失控”杀戮事件的愤怒情绪正在彻底爆发。

据美国国土安全部透露，在墨西哥籍非法移民弗雷迪·奇戈·米尔（Freddi Chigo Mil）因涉嫌在弗吉尼亚州斯汤顿街头刺伤两名女性而被捕后，ICE已向斯潘伯格及“其同僚庇护政客”发出请求，要求不得释放该嫌疑人。警方赶赴案发现场后，发现了米尔以及两名被刺伤的女性，其中一人当场被宣告死亡，另一人则被送往当地医院救治。

根据米德尔河区域监狱（Middle River Regional Jail）的记录，米尔被控二级谋杀罪以及导致永久性残疾的加重恶意伤人罪。就在同一天，ICE在弗吉尼亚州伍德布里奇逮捕了萨尔瓦多籍非法移民尹米·莫利纳-泽佩达（Yinmi Molina-Zepeda），此前当局发现他在其祖国因加重杀人罪及其他罪行而被通缉。

国土安全部长马克韦恩·穆林（Markwayne Mullin）在谈及弗吉尼亚州被控暴力犯罪的非法移民名单不断增加时指出：“这就是弗吉尼亚联邦在州长阿比盖尔·斯潘伯格及其同僚庇护政客推行的庇护政策下沦落成的模样。”

华盛顿特区周边县动用纳税人资金削弱ICE执法引发“窝藏非法外国人”指控

谈及米尔一案，穆林表示：“这名来自墨西哥的非法外国人因在一场致一死一伤的连环刺伤事件中被指控犯有谋杀罪。”

他解释道：“ICE已发出一份拘留令，要求斯潘伯格州长与我们配合，并承诺不会从监狱释放这名罪犯，以便在他接受法律审判后能够被驱逐出境。”

“是时候终结这些原本可以预防的悲剧了，”他继续说道，并补充称：“驱逐非法外国人能够拯救生命。”

受害者权益倡导组织“受害者权利改革委员会”（Victims' Rights Reform Council）执行主任珍妮弗·哈里森（Jennifer Harrison）向福克斯新闻数字频道表示：“在这些颠倒黑白的司法管辖区里，一切都失控了。这些地方由像斯潘伯格这样自称为‘温和派民主党人’的政客掌管，他们推行的政策把罪犯置于受害者和公共安全之上。”

哈里森提出了这样的质问：“在民选官员清醒过来并改弦易辙之前，我们的街头还要流多少血？”

哈里森接着说：“我们已经到了这样一个地步：联邦政府不得不恳求州和地方官员不要将危险的非法移民放回美国社区。想想这有多么疯狂吧。”

“这些人原本从一开始就不应该在这个国家，然而在他们在这里被指控犯下重罪、眼前躺着死者遗体之后，我们竟然还在争论是否应该将他们放回我们的街头。”

法官警告其他蓝州之际，斯潘伯格限制ICE执法的举措遭遇重大挫折

在发布的新闻通报中，国土安全部指出了弗吉尼亚州今年发生的22起涉及非法移民的暴力犯罪案件。今年弗吉尼亚州对非法移民提起的指控包括儿童色情犯罪、针对儿童的性犯罪、企图解除执法人员武装、谋杀、加重性侵犯、强奸、绑架以及其他严重罪行。

斯潘伯格办公室的一名发言人在回应福克斯新闻数字频道时表示，州长“坚信在美国境内的非法暴力罪犯应当受到法律的最大限度起诉并被驱逐出境”。

该发言人称：“在斯潘伯格州长的领导下，弗吉尼亚州惩教部继续维持长期以来的做法，即在非美国本土出生的人员被州拘留期间通知ICE”，并且“弗吉尼亚州执法机构也继续参与特别工作组，并与联邦机构开展跨部门合作”。

他们还补充说：“作为一名前联邦执法官员，曾致力于打击侵害儿童的捕食者，斯潘伯格州长将始终把弗吉尼亚州家庭的安全与福祉放在首位。”

福克斯新闻数字频道也就此事联系了米德尔河区域监狱以寻求评论。

“弗吉尼亚人为了安全社区”组织（Virginians for Safe Communities）主席肖恩·肯尼迪（Sean Kennedy）向福克斯新闻数字频道表示：“斯潘伯格的所作所为并不是支持移民，而是纵容犯罪。”

肯尼迪说：“恰恰因为他们是外国公民而庇护危险罪犯免遭遣返，她是在把掠食者放虎归山到我们的街头。事实上，这些掠食者绝大多数都在残害其他无辜的移民——正是她声称要帮助的那些人。”

观看：“终身民主党人”在儿子死于非法移民车祸后承认对该党“感到羞耻”

他指责斯潘伯格“处处阻挠ICE执法”，从而包庇非法移民罪犯免受惩处，并称：“当这位州长照镜子时，受害者的面孔应该在她心中久久挥之不去。”

“如果非法外国人从一开始就未被允许入境并获准留在这里，那么他们所犯下的每一起谋杀、强奸和抢劫案原本都是可以避免的，”他强调道，并总结称：“他们本不必死。她只需要遵守法律，而不是贯彻她自己的政治议程。”

financeStories.title: Waymo前首席财务官加盟自动驾驶初创公司Wayve
financeStories.originalTitle: Former Waymo CFO jumps to self-driving startup Wayve
financeStories.snippet: Elisa de Martel, who left her position as chief financial officer at Alphabet's autonomous vehicle company Waymo in January, will be based out of Silicon Valley.
financeStories.fullContent:
Elisa de Martel, who was chief financial officer at Alphabet’s autonomous vehicle company Waymo, has been hired to the same position at buzzy self-driving vehicle startup Wayve. Outgoing CFO Max Warburton, who held the position at Wayve since 2024, is moving into a strategic advisory role supporting the company’s leadership team.

Her appointment as CFO comes as Wayve moves from development and testing to a company on the verge of deploying its automated driving technology on two fronts: robotaxis and passenger vehicles.

De Martel, who will be based out of Sunnyvale, California, has a history of working for tech companies, including as CFO at industrial-grade 3D printing company Carbon and an 11-year stint as manufacturing finance director at Apple. She was CFO at Waymo from 2022 to January 2026 — a critical period for the company as it began to commercially operate in several cities and raised $5.6 billion in a Series C fundraising round that was led by its parent company and pushed its valuation to more than $45 billion.

Wayve now sits in a similarly pivotal moment. The startup, which was founded in 2017 and is now valued at about $8.5 billion, attracted investors and automotive customers for its self-learning approach to its automated driving software. The company developed a software layer using an end-to-end neural network that doesn’t rely on high-definition maps, custom hardware, or hand-coded rules and only uses data to teach the vehicle how to drive.

The company’s tech is the basis of two products: an “eyes on” assisted-driving system and an “eyes off” fully automated-driving system, which could be applied to robotaxis or consumer vehicles that can handle all of the driving in certain environments.

Wayve’s pitch, and the agnostic nature of its technology, has resonated with automakers already locked into certain hardware. It’s also attracted investors — Wayve has raised $3.2 billion to date — and companies like Uber that want to use a more capable version of the self-driving tech to deploy robotaxis.

While de Martel has a well-documented career in top financial posts, it was her connection to deep tech that was particularly attractive to Wayve’s leadership, including founder and CEO Alex Kendall, according to insiders who asked not to be named.

As CFO at Wayve, she will oversee financial strategy and planning, capital allocation, reporting, governance, treasury, and tax. The company said she will also work closely with Wayve’s executive team to support and advise on commercial, investor, and strategic partnership deals.

Wayve has locked in a number of partnerships with automakers, including Nissan and Stellantis. The company has also made progress on the automated vehicle driving systems for robotaxis; the company recently launched public rides in London — with a human safety operator on board — and Tokyo is expected to follow soon.

Now the company has to push past this historically precarious point of early and limited deployment and into a high-volume supplier to automotive.

financeStories.fullTranslation:
曾任Alphabet旗下自动驾驶汽车公司Waymo首席财务官的Elisa de Martel，已被自动驾驶汽车初创公司Wayve聘为同一职位。自2024年起担任Wayve首席财务官的Max Warburton即将离任，转任战略顾问，为公司领导团队提供支持。

她获任首席财务官之际，Wayve正从研发和测试阶段迈向即将部署自动驾驶技术的阶段，业务将覆盖两个领域：自动驾驶出租车和乘用车。

De Martel将常驻加利福尼亚州桑尼维尔。她曾在多家科技公司任职，包括工业级3D打印公司Carbon的首席财务官，以及在苹果公司担任制造业财务总监长达11年。2022年至2026年1月，她担任Waymo首席财务官。在此期间，Waymo开始在多个城市开展商业运营，并完成56亿美元C轮融资。这轮融资由其母公司领投，并推动Waymo估值超过450亿美元，对公司而言是一个关键时期。

Wayve如今也处于类似的关键节点。这家成立于2017年、目前估值约85亿美元的初创公司，凭借其自动学习式自动驾驶软件方案吸引了投资者和汽车客户。该公司开发了一层基于端到端神经网络的软件，不依赖高清地图、定制硬件或手工编写的规则，而是仅使用数据来教会车辆如何驾驶。

该公司的技术是两款产品的基础：一款是“需要驾驶员持续关注道路”的辅助驾驶系统，另一款是“无需驾驶员关注道路”的全自动驾驶系统。后者可应用于自动驾驶出租车，或能够在特定环境中完成全部驾驶任务的消费级车辆。

Wayve的主张以及其技术的软硬件无关特性，得到了那些已经锁定特定硬件方案的汽车制造商的认可。该公司也吸引了投资者，以及希望利用能力更强的自动驾驶技术部署自动驾驶出租车的优步等企业。截至目前，Wayve已融资32亿美元。

据不愿透露姓名的知情人士透露，尽管De Martel拥有担任高级财务职位的丰富履历，但Wayve管理层——包括创始人兼首席执行官Alex Kendall——尤其看重的是她与深科技领域的联系。

作为Wayve的首席财务官，她将负责公司的财务战略与规划、资本配置、报告、治理、资金管理和税务工作。公司表示，她还将与Wayve管理团队密切合作，为商业交易、投资者交易和战略合作伙伴交易提供支持与建议。

现在，公司必须跨越早期、有限部署这一历来充满风险的阶段，发展成为一家面向汽车行业的大批量供应商。

financeStories.originalTitle: Hear why Science Corp CEO Max Hodak says the screen era is ending at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
financeStories.snippet: At this year's Disrupt, Science Corp CEO Max Hodak will present a vision for screen-free interfaces that can even offer medical help. Register before September 25 to save up to $200 on your pass.
financeStories.fullContent:
When you imagine working with a computer, you likely think of keyboards, clicks, or typing on your phone. Science Corporation CEO Max Hodak has spent the last several months advancing a different vision. His company has enlisted a top neurobiologist to lead the first U.S. human trials for its biohybrid brain-computer interface. Hodak shares what his company has discovered so far with the 10,000+ tech leaders, founders, and investors at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

At his Beyond Screens session on the Disrupt Stage, Hodak will make the case for why the next era of technology could be built upon a different kind of interface, one that adapts to us from brain-computer interactions to create new ways of engaging with machines.

Join Disrupt as it returns to Moscone West in San Francisco on October 13-15, bringing together more than 10,000 founders, investors, and startup community members across more than 250 sessions. This year, we have a particular focus on building sustainable AI companies, with AI-centric programming extending across six industry stages.

Secure your Disrupt pass today to save up to $200 on your ticket and hear one of Silicon Valley’s most ambitious founders explore a post-screen future.

Hodak’s career reads like a running bet that the interface between humans and machines has plenty of room for improvement. Having started programming at six years old, he studied biomedical engineering at Duke Pratt School of Engineering, and worked his way into Miguel Nicolelis’ brain-computer interface lab, interests that inform his work to this day.

He originally co-founded Transcriptic, a robotic cloud laboratory for the life sciences. But most famously, he co-founded Neuralink in 2016 and served as its initial president, helping build the company that put brain implants into the public imagination. Then in 2021, he founded Science Corporation to develop advanced neural engineering and brain-computer interface technology. The company has a particular focus on applications to aid those in need of help with vision, cognition, and mobility.

And it’s not all speculation: Science Corp’s PRIMA implant has already restored eyesight in people with severe vision loss, using a pair of glasses with a tiny camera that beams a captured scene onto a chip implanted in the retina. Since its founding, it’s raised $230 million in a Series C round at a $1.5 billion valuation, and the company’s ambitions go beyond interfaces. Hodak sees additional applications of Science Corp’s brain-implanted sensors helping heal damaged brain cells, warning about seizures, and maybe even helping treat conditions as severe as Parkinson’s disease.

This is your best chance to learn how Hodak thinks the interface between people and machines is about to change, and the many ways that could impact your startup, your role, and maybe your life.

financeStories.fullContent:
Samus is geared up for another adventure. | Image: Nintendo

The Metroid series is going back to its 2D roots again with Metroid Ravenous for the Nintendo Switch 2, the first side-scrolling game in the series since 2021’s Metroid Dread for the Nintendo Switch. If you’re already excited enough to consider preordering, you can save $10 on the physical version of the game when you buy it from Walmart. It’s $59.88 instead of $69.99, about the same as buying it digitally. The game launches on January 28th, 2027, but it’s not clear how long the preorder discount will last. If it’s anything like other Walmart preorders , it may occasionally disappear.

$69.99 $59.88 at Walmart

Nintendo first showed off the side-scrolling adventure game at its September 2026 Direct , with a frantic trailer cutting between cinematic sequences, Samus dashing and rolling across a variety of environments, and engaging a number of enemies and bosses in battle. Samus absorbs some powerful abilities at the conclusion of Dread , and Ravenous seem to be all about plowing through anyone stopping her from escaping the planet. Other details of the story, including unique new mechanics, are being kept under wraps for the time being.

If you haven’t played Metroid Dread , I recommend it, especially at its $41.99 discounted price at Amazon . It’s part of Nintendo’s “Customer Appreciation” sale happening through September 26th, and several other games and accessories are cheaper, too.

financeStories.title: GitHub在计数方面遇到了问题
financeStories.originalTitle: GitHub is having trouble counting things
financeStories.fullContent:
In the past week, I’ve noticed two pretty severe UI bugs in GitHub. The first is an overcounting of PRs in the tab on a repository, this is particularly common after you merge a PR, but it’s not the only trigger of this behavior. To add insult to injury, the right count is even right there on this page.

The second occurred while I was trying to set up Sentry. I’ve been using GitHub for 11 years now, so I have collected three pages of org memberships. Unfortunately for me, the project I’m setting up Sentry for is on the second page.

For some reason, Chrome doesn’t let you modify the address in the bar for these pop-up windows. Luckily, you can force navigate using JavaScript.

Really curious as to what’s going on over there, if you’ve got any insight let me know!
financeStories.fullTranslation:
过去一周，我注意到 GitHub 中存在两个相当严重的界面漏洞。第一个是仓库标签页中对 PR 数量的重复计算，这种情况在合并 PR 后尤其常见，但这并不是触发该行为的唯一原因。更糟的是，正确的数量其实就在这个页面上。

第二个问题发生在我尝试设置 Sentry 时。我使用 GitHub 已经 11 年了，因此积累了整整三页组织成员资格。对我来说不幸的是，我要为其设置 Sentry 的项目位于第二页。

出于某种原因，Chrome 不允许你修改这些弹出窗口地址栏中的地址。幸运的是，你可以使用 JavaScript 强制跳转。

我真的很好奇那边到底发生了什么；如果你有什么见解，请告诉我！

financeStories.fullContent:

The company could borrow tech from Nvidia to make it happen.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All by Terrence O'Brien

According to The Information, Apple is planning to get back into the server game and might just pair up with Nvidia to make it happen. Apple retired its Xserve line in 2011 and has largely left enterprise machines to other manufacturers since. But the growing demand for compute power as the AI industry continues to expand has apparently led the company to believe there is an opening for its powerful but efficient ARM-based M processors. Its Mac Mini and Mac Studio have proven popular with AI developers, which has led to shortages.

The server product, whether it’s called Xserve or something else, likely won’t debut until 2029. Word is that it will run on two or four (depending on the model) M8 Ultra chips. Apple only just announced the M6 in August, so the M8 line is a ways out.

It’s also rumored that Apple’s servers could incorporate Nvidia’s NVLink Fusion tech, which connects multiple chips together so they can operate as one. While the two companies have historically had a frosty relationship behind the scenes, recently Apple turned to Nvidia chips to power its revamped Siri servers. Incorporating NVLink could lead to further collaboration between the two, but plans could still change.

financeStories.title: 你的人工智能代理现在可以控制 Google Home 设备
financeStories.originalTitle: Your AI agents can now control your Google Home devices
financeStories.snippet: Google is launching early access to a new MCP server for Google Home, allowing AI agents like Claude, ChatGPT, and others to control connected devices, review camera summaries, and access smart home activity using natural language.
financeStories.fullContent:
Smart home owners will soon be able to control their devices connected to Google Home via an AI agent. On Wednesday, Google rolled out early access to its Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for its Google Home ecosystem, which will allow any AI agent that supports MCP — like Claude, Hermes, OpenClaw, ChatGPT, and Google Antigravity — to securely work with their smart home devices and access their event history.

This update will allow people to use natural language instructions to do things like review their camera summaries, monitor smart home activity, control their connected devices, and build their own custom smart home dashboards.

To get the connection set up, users will need to create a Google Cloud project and configure it to use Home MCP. They will then provide the MCP configuration details to their agent of choice and ask it to set it up. The agent will then ask them to sign in and grant permissions. (A setup guide will also be offered in the Google Home Developer Center.)

The system will support any device in the Google Home ecosystem, including Google Nest doorbells and thermostats and “Works with Google Home” (or Matter) devices, like light bulbs.

Google already supports MCP in other areas of its business, including in its Google Cloud and data platforms, developer tools, and Google Workspace, for instance. Support for Google Home is targeted more directly at consumers who are experimenting with AI agents designed to handle everyday tasks.

Google wouldn’t comment on if or when the MCP would roll out more broadly, such as to other subscription tiers or markets.

Google is also soliciting feedback from early adopters during this period by way of its Smart Home for Developers Community, it says.

An earlier version of this post misstated the rollout’s start. It is today, Wednesday, not Tuesday.

这项更新将允许用户通过自然语言指令完成多项操作，例如查看摄像头摘要、监控智能家居活动、控制已连接设备，以及创建自定义智能家居仪表板。

要完成连接设置，用户需要创建一个 Google Cloud 项目，并将其配置为使用 Home MCP。随后，他们需要把 MCP 配置详情提供给自己选择的代理，并要求代理完成设置。之后，代理会要求用户登录并授予权限。（Google Home 开发者中心也将提供设置指南。）

该系统将支持 Google Home 生态系统中的任何设备，包括 Google Nest 门铃和恒温器，以及灯泡等“支持 Google Home”或 Matter 设备。

谷歌已经在其业务的其他领域支持 MCP，例如 Google Cloud 和数据平台、开发者工具以及 Google Workspace。Google Home 对 MCP 的支持则更直接地面向那些正在尝试使用人工智能代理处理日常任务的消费者。

谷歌不愿置评 MCP 何时或是否会更广泛地推出，例如扩展到其他订阅层级或市场。

谷歌表示，在此期间还将通过其“面向开发者的智能家居社区”征求早期用户的反馈。

本文早期版本错误地表述了此次发布的开始时间。发布是在今天，即周三，而不是周二。

当你通过我们文章中的链接购买商品时，我们可能会获得一小笔佣金。这不会影响我们的编辑独立性。

financeStories.title: 索尼初代 PlayStation 2 的安全芯片在问世 26 年后被“彻底攻破”
financeStories.originalTitle: Original Sony PlayStation 2 security chip ‘broken wide open’ after 26 years
financeStories.fullContent:
Breakthrough will improve hardware preservation, repair, and emulation projects.

When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

The ‘magic security chip’ inside the original PlayStation 2 has been successfully reverse-engineered and dumped. Canadian retro hardware and software enthusiast DiscoStarslayer was the manic mind behind the cracking open of the CXP102064 MechaCon chip, which arrived inside the ‘PS2 Fat’ from 1999. It took “four years of effort” to reach this stage, but this milestone should be a boon to hardware preservation, repair, and emulation projects.

After 4 years of effort, I'm happy to announce that one of the final secrets of the PS2 has been broken wide open!It's been a long process of decapping, optical dumping, and now at last a software solution.Thank you Libby for finding the exploit from our dirty optical dumps! pic.twitter.com/VrsCH8I35CSeptember 13, 2026

The Mechacon got its name from its primary duty of controlling the PS2’s optical and flash drive mechanics. It also played a significant part in Sony’s game optical disc security, supporting “Magic Gate [memory card] and KELF file [executable] decryption among other things,” notes the PSDev Wiki. Unlocking the secret workings of such chips can be important to those involved in video game preservation. So, many people will appreciate DiscoStarslayer’s work in reverse engineering and dumping one of the PS2’s last remaining secrets.

As per the social media post, the arduous task of breaking the MechaCon’s security took four years. Some of the reverse engineering tricks utilized by DiscoStarslayer include chemically decapping the CXP102064 to expose the die, then using microscopes and optical dumping skills to analyze the silicon chip circuitry. In this case, a lucky break during the hacking apparently uncovered an exploit that provided a method whereby the chip’s data could be extracted through software.

With this achievement unlocked, the game/hardware preservation and programming communities can look forward to improved emulation and homebrew developments. It should also open up possibilities for replacing the aging optical drives in PS2 consoles.

Beyond the confines of PS2 Fat consoles, some social media commenters noted that the MechaCon was also used in a handful of arcade machines from the era. Specifically, the Namco System 246 and System 256, as well as the Konami Python 1, which used modified PS2 hardware, used the MechaCon firmware to authenticate security and allow the execution of encrypted game data.

这一突破将推动硬件保存、维修和模拟器项目的发展。

初代 PlayStation 2 内部的“魔法安全芯片”已被成功逆向工程分析并导出数据。加拿大复古硬件与软件爱好者 DiscoStarslayer 是破解 CXP102064 MechaCon 芯片的幕后主力。这款芯片搭载于 1999 年推出的“厚机版 PS2”中。经过“四年的努力”，相关工作终于取得这一进展，而这一里程碑式成果将有望推动硬件保存、维修和模拟器项目的发展。

经过 4 年的努力，我很高兴地宣布，PS2 的最后几个秘密之一终于被彻底攻破！这是一个漫长的过程：先是去封装，再进行光学数据导出，如今终于找到了软件解决方案。感谢 Libby 从我们粗糙的光学导出数据中发现了漏洞！

2026 年 9 月 13 日

MechaCon 得名于其主要职责，即控制 PS2 的光驱和闪存驱动器机械结构。它还在索尼游戏光盘安全机制中发挥了重要作用。PSDev Wiki 指出，该芯片支持“Magic Gate［存储卡］以及 KELF 文件［可执行文件］解密等功能”。对于从事电子游戏保存工作的人来说，解锁此类芯片的秘密运行机制可能十分重要。因此，许多人都会认可 DiscoStarslayer 对 PS2 最后几个未解秘密之一进行逆向工程并导出数据的工作。

根据这条社交媒体帖文，破解 MechaCon 安全机制这一艰巨任务耗时四年。DiscoStarslayer 采用的部分逆向工程技巧包括：通过化学方法去除 CXP102064 的封装以暴露芯片裸片，然后利用显微镜和光学数据导出技术分析硅芯片电路。在此次工作中，破解过程中似乎意外发现了一个漏洞，为通过软件提取芯片数据提供了方法。

随着这一成就解锁，游戏与硬件保存以及编程社区可以期待模拟器和自制软件开发得到改善。这一成果还应当为替换 PS2 游戏机中老化的光驱带来更多可能性。

除了厚机版 PS2 游戏机之外，一些社交媒体评论者还指出，同一时期有少量街机设备也使用了 MechaCon。具体而言，采用改装 PS2 硬件的 Namco System 246、System 256 以及 Konami Python 1，都使用 MechaCon 固件来验证安全机制，并允许运行加密的游戏数据。

financeStories.title: “铁蛋白脸”：席卷社交媒体的新健康恐慌
financeStories.originalTitle: Ferritin face: the new health scare taking social media by storm
financeStories.source: The Guardian Society (卫报社会与民生)
financeStories.snippet: Seeing a pallid, washed-out face in the mirror? Prepare to be diagnosed … Name: Ferritin face. Age: The name is new, but the symptoms are old. Continue reading...
financeStories.fullContent:
Seeing a pallid, washed-out face in the mirror? Prepare to be diagnosed …

Name: Ferritin face.

Age: The name is new, but the symptoms are old.

Symptoms: Pallor, dull skin, dark circles under your eyes. Looking washed out, basically.

What are you, a mirror? Oh no, does this describe you? Do you also have ferritin face?

Aren’t those just symptoms for “looking tired”? Is this one of those social media health scares with little to no scientific basis? No! I mean, yes, the term has recently become very popular on social media, as reported in the Washington Post. Ferritin face is not a real medical term (nor are there consistent criteria that define it) – but ferritin at least is definitely a thing.

Tell me about ferritin, then. It’s a complex globular protein that stores iron in the body in its inactive form. If you have low ferritin levels, it could indicate an iron deficiency.

And what happens if I have an iron deficiency? If it is severe and goes untreated for long enough, it could lead to tachycardia, breathlessness, chest pain and heart complications.

This is terrible! How can I cure myself? Well, earlier this summer, Allure magazine wrote a long piece entitled What It Means to Have “Ferritin Face”, calling iron deficiency an epidemic that women are prone to. It had plenty of advice.

Like what? Tell me now, before my dark circles kill me! It can often be overcome with a change of diet, as meat and green leafy vegetables are a good source. But you can also just go and have an intravenous iron infusion.

An IV it is! Be warned that, according to a leading iron infusion clinic, it could cost you in the region of £800.

Cabbage! Someone get me a cabbage! Alternatively, you could stop crapping your pants at every social media health scare. You should never diagnose and treat yourself via TikTok clips.

OK, fine. Think it about it sensibly. There is a vast difference between ferritin face and actual anaemia. Anaemia doesn’t just make you pale and tired-looking; it can leave you fatigued and breathless, with headaches, dizziness, palpitations and a loss of concentration being common symptoms.

Oh, I don’t have any of those. Good. But if you do, the NHS recommends that you see a GP, who will try to discover the underlying reason for your iron deficiency – which could be anything from heavy periods to cancer – and put you on a course of iron tablets.

So I don’t need to worry about ferritin. Probably not, no. But get an early night tonight. You look dreadful.

Do say: “You do not have ferritin face.”

Don’t say: “But you do have ferreting face, which is far worse.”
financeStories.fullTranslation:
在镜子里看到一张苍白、毫无血色的脸？准备好接受诊断吧……

名称：铁蛋白脸。

年龄：这个名称是新出现的，但症状却由来已久。

症状：脸色苍白、皮肤暗淡、眼下有黑眼圈。基本上就是看起来面色憔悴、毫无血色。

你这是镜子吗？哦，不，这说的不就是你吗？难道你也有铁蛋白脸？

这些不就是“看起来很疲惫”的症状吗？这是不是又一种几乎没有科学依据的社交媒体健康恐慌？不！我的意思是，是的，这个词最近在社交媒体上大为流行，《华盛顿邮报》对此也有报道。铁蛋白脸并不是一个真正的医学术语（也没有界定它的一套统一标准）——但至少，铁蛋白确实是实实在在存在的东西。

那就跟我说说铁蛋白吧。铁蛋白是一种复杂的球状蛋白质，以非活性形式储存人体内的铁。如果铁蛋白水平偏低，可能意味着缺铁。

如果我缺铁，会发生什么？如果缺铁严重，而且长期得不到治疗，可能导致心动过速、呼吸困难、胸痛以及心脏并发症。

太可怕了！我该怎么治好自己？今年初夏，《魅力》杂志刊登了一篇题为《拥有“铁蛋白脸”意味着什么》的长篇文章，称缺铁是女性容易受到影响的一种流行病。文章给出了大量建议。

比如呢？趁我的黑眼圈还没要了我的命，赶紧告诉我！通常可以通过改变饮食来改善，因为肉类以及绿叶蔬菜都是铁的良好来源。不过，你也可以直接去接受静脉输铁。

那就打点滴吧！但要注意，据一家知名输铁诊所介绍，这可能要花费约800英镑。

卷心菜！快给我找一棵卷心菜来！或者，你也可以别再因为社交媒体上的每一次健康恐慌而吓得屁滚尿流。你绝不应该通过TikTok短视频给自己下诊断、治病。

好吧，知道了。理性地想一想。铁蛋白脸和真正的贫血之间存在天壤之别。贫血不只是让你脸色苍白、看起来疲惫；它还会让你感到乏力、呼吸困难，头痛、头晕、心悸以及注意力不集中也都是常见症状。

哦，这些症状我一个都没有。那就好。但如果你有这些症状，英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）建议你去看全科医生。医生会设法找出你缺铁的根本原因——可能是月经过多，也可能是癌症——并让你接受一段时间的铁片治疗。

所以我不用担心铁蛋白了。大概不用，是的。不过今晚早点睡。你看起来糟透了。

可以说：“你没有铁蛋白脸。”

不要说：“但你有一张翻箱倒柜脸，那糟糕得多。”

financeStories.title: 用 Delta 替代拉取请求
financeStories.fullContent:
September 16th, 2026

Today, we're launching the public beta of Delta, a multiplayer environment for coding with agents and reviewing what they build. We're building Delta because agents have fundamentally changed the way we write software, but our collaborative tooling isn't keeping up.

Last week, we crossed a key milestone: we disabled pull requests on Delta's own repository. We now build and collaborate on Delta entirely within Delta.

What makes Delta different from traditional workflows is that collaboration doesn't depend on committing and pushing code. You invite teammates directly into your conversations with agents. When someone joins your thread, they see the same worktrees you do and can work with them on their own machine. Teammates can ask the same agent why you chose a Mutex instead of an RwLock. If you log off, they can keep working with the agent where you left off.

Starting today, anyone can download Delta for macOS, Linux, or Windows, use it on the web without downloading anything, and keep up with threads from a mobile browser on the go.

Since GitHub introduced pull requests over 15 years ago, they've become the standard way to ask teammates to review changes to your codebase. But with agents generating so much code, the diffs we're asking each other to review have mushroomed.

Splitting a big diff across a stack of branches can make it easier to navigate, but the decisions behind the code still need review. Smaller diffs don't supply that context. A reviewer may feed your diff into another agent to help understand it, but that agent has to piece together decisions you already worked through.

Why should your teammate's agent have to guess how you got there?

In Delta, you can invite anyone to pick up a thread where you left off, or create a dedicated review subthread. A review guides you through your branch's changes with access to the original agent's context. Each review gets its own isolated copy of the parent thread's worktrees, so you and your teammates can use agents to explore the code and try changes without disrupting the original work. If a reviewer spots a problem, they can request a revision or work with an agent to fix it themselves. Fixes made during review can be incorporated into the parent thread before you ask the agent to land the change.

Delta is built on DeltaDB, which extends Git's content-based versioning with incremental versions based on deltas. It records edits between commits alongside messages from humans and agents, preserving how the code evolved throughout a thread. A commit remains the checkpoint you push, pull, and build from. DeltaDB retains the work between those checkpoints.

You don't have to move your whole team into Delta to use it.

For example, zed-industries/zed will remain on GitHub for now because it's where our community finds issues and submits changes. We're encouraging Zed contributors to share Delta threads alongside their pull requests. Contributors can work together in Delta while continuing to submit changes through GitHub, and teammates who never open Delta still see a normal Git repository.

It seems like everyone is in a race to replace GitHub right now. Most contenders promise better uptime on top of the same old primitives: branches, commits, and diffs.

We believe that threads will be the new fundamental unit of software development, and the best way to model their state is with deltas.

Pull requests are the first part of the GitHub workflow we're leaving behind. In their place is the Delta thread, and with it a way of working we call continuous engineering. The industry made integration continuous, then delivery, while the rest of software engineering still happened in batches. In a Delta thread, the idea, implementation, review, and landing of the changes can all happen in the same place.

We're building better alternatives for the other workflows that bring developers to GitHub.com, starting with Git storage in DeltaDB. Longer term, content-based builds could bring CI-style verification directly into the thread. For now, an agent can trigger a run with an existing CI provider and check the results before landing the change.

Thank you to the thousands of people who requested early access and helped us find Delta's rough edges. Delta is forming, and some of the capabilities we care most about are ahead (follow what we're building next here). But it's already our daily driver: 33 of us have landed 570 changes to main since we turned off pull requests.

During the public beta, Delta is free. We'll introduce paid plans soon for individuals and teams. There will always be a free version of Delta.

Download Delta, kick off an agent, invite a teammate into the thread, and feel the magic. We'd love to hear how it goes.

Check out similar blogs from the Zed team.

You can try Zed today on macOS, Windows, or Linux. Download now!

If you're passionate about the topics we cover on our blog, please consider joining our team to help us ship the future of software development.
financeStories.fullTranslation:
2026年9月16日

今天，我们推出了 Delta 的公开测试版。Delta 是一个用于与代理协作编程并审查代理所构建内容的多人环境。我们之所以构建 Delta，是因为代理从根本上改变了我们编写软件的方式，但我们的协作工具却没有跟上这一变化。

上周，我们跨过了一个关键里程碑：我们禁用了 Delta 自有代码仓库中的拉取请求。现在，我们完全在 Delta 内构建 Delta，并开展协作。

Delta 与传统工作流的不同之处在于，协作不依赖于提交和推送代码。你可以直接邀请队友加入你与代理的对话。当有人加入你的线程时，他们会看到与你相同的工作树，并可以在自己的机器上使用这些工作树开展工作。队友可以询问同一个代理：你为什么选择 Mutex，而不是 RwLock。如果你退出登录，他们仍然可以从你离开的地方继续与代理协作。

从今天开始，任何人都可以下载适用于 macOS、Linux 或 Windows 的 Delta；也可以直接在网页上使用，无需下载任何内容；还可以随时通过移动浏览器跟进线程。

自 GitHub 在 15 多年前推出拉取请求以来，拉取请求一直是邀请队友审查代码库变更的标准方式。但随着代理生成的代码越来越多，我们要求彼此审查的差异内容也急剧膨胀。

将一个大型差异拆分到一系列分支中，可以让浏览更容易，但代码背后的决策仍然需要审查。较小的差异无法提供这些背景信息。审查者可能会把你的差异交给另一个代理，以帮助理解它，但那个代理必须重新拼凑出你已经做过的决策。

为什么队友的代理必须猜测你是如何走到这一步的？

在 Delta 中，你可以邀请任何人从你离开的地方继续一个线程，也可以创建一个专门的审查子线程。审查会引导你了解分支中的变更，同时能够访问原始代理的上下文。每次审查都会获得一份父线程工作树的独立副本，因此你和队友可以使用代理探索代码并尝试修改，而不会干扰原始工作。如果审查者发现问题，他们可以要求修改，也可以与代理协作自行修复。审查期间完成的修复，可以在你要求代理合入变更之前纳入父线程。

Delta 构建于 DeltaDB 之上。DeltaDB 在 Git 基于内容的版本控制基础上，增加了基于差异的增量版本。它会记录提交之间的编辑，以及人类和代理发送的消息，从而保留整个线程中代码的演变过程。提交仍然是你进行推送、拉取和构建所依据的检查点。DeltaDB 则保留这些检查点之间的工作内容。

你不必把整个团队都迁移到 Delta 才能使用它。

例如，zed-industries/zed 目前仍将保留在 GitHub 上，因为我们的社区在那里发现问题并提交变更。我们鼓励 Zed 贡献者在拉取请求旁边分享 Delta 线程。贡献者可以继续通过 GitHub 提交变更，同时在 Delta 中协作；而那些从未打开过 Delta 的队友，仍然只能看到一个普通的 Git 代码仓库。

现在看来，所有人似乎都在竞相取代 GitHub。大多数竞争者承诺在同样的老旧基础原语——分支、提交和差异——之上提供更好的正常运行时间。

我们相信，线程将成为软件开发新的基本单元，而使用差异来建模线程状态是最佳方式。

拉取请求是我们将要舍弃的 GitHub 工作流的第一部分。取而代之的是 Delta 线程，以及一种我们称为“持续工程”的工作方式。这个行业先让集成实现了持续化，随后又让交付实现了持续化，而软件工程的其他环节仍然以批次方式进行。在 Delta 线程中，变更的构想、实现、审查和合入都可以在同一个地方完成。

我们正在为其他促使开发者使用 GitHub.com 的工作流构建更好的替代方案，首先从 DeltaDB 中的 Git 存储开始。从长期来看，基于内容的构建可以将类似 CI 的验证直接带入线程。目前，代理可以通过现有的 CI 服务提供商触发一次运行，并在合入变更之前检查结果。

感谢数千名申请早期访问并帮助我们发现 Delta 不足之处的人。Delta 仍在成形，一些我们最为重视的功能还在路上（你可以在这里关注我们接下来正在构建的内容）。但它已经是我们日常使用的主要工具：自从关闭拉取请求以来，我们 33 个人已经向主分支合入了 570 项变更。

在公开测试期间，Delta 免费提供。我们很快将为个人和团队推出付费方案。Delta 始终会提供免费版本。

下载 Delta，启动一个代理，邀请队友加入线程，亲自感受其中的神奇。我们很想听听你的使用体验。

查看 Zed 团队发布的其他类似博客文章。

你今天就可以在 macOS、Windows 或 Linux 上试用 Zed。立即下载！

如果你热衷于我们博客所涵盖的主题，请考虑加入我们的团队，帮助我们推出软件开发的未来。

aiStories.title: 在被指责售卖“偷窥眼镜”后，Meta准备推出一款不带摄像头的眼镜
aiStories.originalTitle: After accusations of selling ‘perv glasses,’ Meta prepares to sell a pair without a camera
aiStories.snippet: Can Meta dodge the "pervert glasses" accusations with a new camera-free product?
aiStories.fullContent:
Meta’s camera-equipped smart glasses have proven more successful than other entrants into the market, but they have also deeply disturbed certain consumers who see them as invasive emblems of a dystopian surveillance society run amok. Now, as the company weathers complaints that it’s selling “pervert glasses,” it has reportedly decided to sell a pair that doesn’t come with integrated spy equipment.

The Information reports that Meta has developed a new smart glasses model, dubbed Luna, that, sans cameras, comes equipped with a convenient system to communicate with the company’s AI chatbot and Muse, its AI consumer agent. The glasses include six built-in microphones so users can communicate with the chatbot, as well as a button on the side of the glasses that, when pressed, activates the AI system.

Luna may be unveiled as soon as Meta Connect, the outlet notes; the event takes place next week.

TechCrunch reached out to Meta for more information.

The smart glasses industry has grown over the past few years, with Meta positioned near the front of the pack of providers. However, concerns over usability, cost, and privacy have dogged the business, with many consumers still unsure of how, why, or if they should use the devices. Meta’s Reality Labs, which is responsible for developing its smart glasses line, is still losing a gargantuan amount of money, its earnings report from April revealed.

aiStories.title: X现在将允许美国用户通过Cashtags进行交易
aiStories.originalTitle: X will now let US users trade via Cashtags
aiStories.snippet: The move closes the gap between the market discussions taking place on the timeline, and the market itself.
aiStories.fullContent:
X will now allow users to trade from their timelines. The Elon Musk-owned social network on Wednesday launched a feature called Cashtag that will let U.S. users on X place stock trades via participating brokerages. Initial partners on the effort include Interactive Brokers, Moomoo, Gemini, Kraken, and Coinbase.

The move takes advantage of what users on X have been doing for years: talking about stocks and, in more recent years, crypto. In 2008, the financial platform StockTwits even came up with the idea for X-precursor Twitter’s Cashtags, which placed a dollar sign ($) in front of stock ticker symbols to make market conversations easy to find and reference.

However, those Cashtags were about tracking the conversations around a particular stock, not actually trading them. Now that X has moved into the financial space with X Money, that’s changed.

Now, Cashtags, which turn ticker symbols for stocks, ETFs, and cryptocurrencies, will give X users the option to trade stocks.

“Cashtags close the gap between a ticker on the timeline and the market itself. When you post or tap a ticker, you’re taken right to the asset, where you have seamless access to the live chart, the conversation around it, and now the ability to trade with one of our brokerage partners,” said Mridul Singhai, X Product Engineering Lead, in a statement shared with TechCrunch.

“With our Cashtag partners, we’re connecting the financial conversation to action. People come to X to discover what’s happening, shape the conversation, and act in real-time on what matters to them,” Monique Pintarelli, SpaceXAI’s Head of Global Advertising, said in a statement. “Our Cashtag partners make it possible to move seamlessly from discovery and conversation to a brokerage, without breaking the moment.”

However, the feature could spur more market manipulation by the way of AI-controlled bots, spammers, and other bad actors, who could attempt to shift the conversation in one direction or another. But one could argue that this is already happening on X today, even without the direct connection to brokerages.

X现在将允许用户直接在时间线上进行交易。这家由埃隆·马斯克持有的社交网络周三推出了一项名为Cashtag的功能，允许X平台上的美国用户通过参与合作的券商下达股票交易指令。该项目的初始合作伙伴包括盈透证券（Interactive Brokers）、Moomoo、Gemini、Kraken和Coinbase。

这一举措利用了X用户多年来一直在做的事情：讨论股票，以及近些年来讨论加密货币。2008年，金融平台StockTwits甚至提出了X前身Twitter的Cashtags概念，即在股票代码前加上美元符号（$），以便人们更容易找到和引用市场讨论。

不过，这些Cashtags此前只是用于追踪围绕某只股票展开的讨论，并不能真正交易相关股票。如今，随着X通过X Money进军金融领域，情况发生了变化。

现在，Cashtags会识别股票、交易所交易基金（ETF）和加密货币的代码，并为X用户提供交易股票的选项。

X产品工程负责人Mridul Singhai在与TechCrunch分享的一份声明中表示：“Cashtags弥合了时间线上的代码与市场本身之间的差距。当你发布或点击某个代码时，系统会直接将你带到相关资产页面，在那里你可以无缝查看实时图表、围绕该资产的讨论，以及现在通过我们的某家券商合作伙伴进行交易的能力。”

SpaceXAI全球广告负责人Monique Pintarelli在一份声明中表示：“通过Cashtag合作伙伴，我们正在把金融讨论与行动连接起来。人们来到X，是为了发现正在发生的事情、塑造讨论，并实时对他们关心的事情采取行动。我们的Cashtag合作伙伴让用户能够从发现和讨论无缝转到券商，而不会打断这一时刻。”

不过，这项功能可能会因人工智能控制的机器人、垃圾信息发送者和其他不良行为者而助长更多市场操纵行为。这些人可能试图将讨论引向某个方向。但也有人可以认为，即使没有与券商的直接连接，这种情况如今已经在X上发生了。

当您通过我们文章中的链接购买商品时，我们可能会获得一小笔佣金。这不会影响我们的编辑独立性。

aiStories.title: Waymo前首席财务官加盟自动驾驶初创公司Wayve
aiStories.originalTitle: Former Waymo CFO jumps to self-driving startup Wayve
aiStories.snippet: Elisa de Martel, who left her position as chief financial officer at Alphabet's autonomous vehicle company Waymo in January, will be based out of Silicon Valley.
aiStories.fullContent:
Elisa de Martel, who was chief financial officer at Alphabet’s autonomous vehicle company Waymo, has been hired to the same position at buzzy self-driving vehicle startup Wayve. Outgoing CFO Max Warburton, who held the position at Wayve since 2024, is moving into a strategic advisory role supporting the company’s leadership team.

Her appointment as CFO comes as Wayve moves from development and testing to a company on the verge of deploying its automated driving technology on two fronts: robotaxis and passenger vehicles.

De Martel, who will be based out of Sunnyvale, California, has a history of working for tech companies, including as CFO at industrial-grade 3D printing company Carbon and an 11-year stint as manufacturing finance director at Apple. She was CFO at Waymo from 2022 to January 2026 — a critical period for the company as it began to commercially operate in several cities and raised $5.6 billion in a Series C fundraising round that was led by its parent company and pushed its valuation to more than $45 billion.

Wayve now sits in a similarly pivotal moment. The startup, which was founded in 2017 and is now valued at about $8.5 billion, attracted investors and automotive customers for its self-learning approach to its automated driving software. The company developed a software layer using an end-to-end neural network that doesn’t rely on high-definition maps, custom hardware, or hand-coded rules and only uses data to teach the vehicle how to drive.

The company’s tech is the basis of two products: an “eyes on” assisted-driving system and an “eyes off” fully automated-driving system, which could be applied to robotaxis or consumer vehicles that can handle all of the driving in certain environments.

Wayve’s pitch, and the agnostic nature of its technology, has resonated with automakers already locked into certain hardware. It’s also attracted investors — Wayve has raised $3.2 billion to date — and companies like Uber that want to use a more capable version of the self-driving tech to deploy robotaxis.

While de Martel has a well-documented career in top financial posts, it was her connection to deep tech that was particularly attractive to Wayve’s leadership, including founder and CEO Alex Kendall, according to insiders who asked not to be named.

As CFO at Wayve, she will oversee financial strategy and planning, capital allocation, reporting, governance, treasury, and tax. The company said she will also work closely with Wayve’s executive team to support and advise on commercial, investor, and strategic partnership deals.

Wayve has locked in a number of partnerships with automakers, including Nissan and Stellantis. The company has also made progress on the automated vehicle driving systems for robotaxis; the company recently launched public rides in London — with a human safety operator on board — and Tokyo is expected to follow soon.

Now the company has to push past this historically precarious point of early and limited deployment and into a high-volume supplier to automotive.

曾任Alphabet旗下自动驾驶汽车公司Waymo首席财务官的Elisa de Martel，已被自动驾驶汽车初创公司Wayve聘为同一职位。自2024年起担任Wayve首席财务官的Max Warburton即将离任，转任战略顾问，为公司领导团队提供支持。

她获任首席财务官之际，Wayve正从研发和测试阶段迈向即将部署自动驾驶技术的阶段，业务将覆盖两个领域：自动驾驶出租车和乘用车。

De Martel将常驻加利福尼亚州桑尼维尔。她曾在多家科技公司任职，包括工业级3D打印公司Carbon的首席财务官，以及在苹果公司担任制造业财务总监长达11年。2022年至2026年1月，她担任Waymo首席财务官。在此期间，Waymo开始在多个城市开展商业运营，并完成56亿美元C轮融资。这轮融资由其母公司领投，并推动Waymo估值超过450亿美元，对公司而言是一个关键时期。

Wayve如今也处于类似的关键节点。这家成立于2017年、目前估值约85亿美元的初创公司，凭借其自动学习式自动驾驶软件方案吸引了投资者和汽车客户。该公司开发了一层基于端到端神经网络的软件，不依赖高清地图、定制硬件或手工编写的规则，而是仅使用数据来教会车辆如何驾驶。

该公司的技术是两款产品的基础：一款是“需要驾驶员持续关注道路”的辅助驾驶系统，另一款是“无需驾驶员关注道路”的全自动驾驶系统。后者可应用于自动驾驶出租车，或能够在特定环境中完成全部驾驶任务的消费级车辆。

Wayve的主张以及其技术的软硬件无关特性，得到了那些已经锁定特定硬件方案的汽车制造商的认可。该公司也吸引了投资者，以及希望利用能力更强的自动驾驶技术部署自动驾驶出租车的优步等企业。截至目前，Wayve已融资32亿美元。

据不愿透露姓名的知情人士透露，尽管De Martel拥有担任高级财务职位的丰富履历，但Wayve管理层——包括创始人兼首席执行官Alex Kendall——尤其看重的是她与深科技领域的联系。

作为Wayve的首席财务官，她将负责公司的财务战略与规划、资本配置、报告、治理、资金管理和税务工作。公司表示，她还将与Wayve管理团队密切合作，为商业交易、投资者交易和战略合作伙伴交易提供支持与建议。

Wayve已经与包括日产和Stellantis在内的多家汽车制造商确定了合作关系。该公司在自动驾驶出租车系统方面也取得了进展；近期，公司在伦敦推出了公众试乘服务，车内配备一名人类安全操作员，预计东京也将很快跟进。

现在，公司必须跨越早期、有限部署这一历来充满风险的阶段，发展成为一家面向汽车行业的大批量供应商。

aiStories.title: 在TechCrunch Disrupt 2026上，听Science Corp首席执行官马克斯·霍达克解释屏幕时代为何正在终结
aiStories.originalTitle: Hear why Science Corp CEO Max Hodak says the screen era is ending at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
aiStories.snippet: At this year's Disrupt, Science Corp CEO Max Hodak will present a vision for screen-free interfaces that can even offer medical help. Register before September 25 to save up to $200 on your pass.
aiStories.fullContent:
When you imagine working with a computer, you likely think of keyboards, clicks, or typing on your phone. Science Corporation CEO Max Hodak has spent the last several months advancing a different vision. His company has enlisted a top neurobiologist to lead the first U.S. human trials for its biohybrid brain-computer interface. Hodak shares what his company has discovered so far with the 10,000+ tech leaders, founders, and investors at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

At his Beyond Screens session on the Disrupt Stage, Hodak will make the case for why the next era of technology could be built upon a different kind of interface, one that adapts to us from brain-computer interactions to create new ways of engaging with machines.

Join Disrupt as it returns to Moscone West in San Francisco on October 13-15, bringing together more than 10,000 founders, investors, and startup community members across more than 250 sessions. This year, we have a particular focus on building sustainable AI companies, with AI-centric programming extending across six industry stages.

Secure your Disrupt pass today to save up to $200 on your ticket and hear one of Silicon Valley’s most ambitious founders explore a post-screen future.

Hodak’s career reads like a running bet that the interface between humans and machines has plenty of room for improvement. Having started programming at six years old, he studied biomedical engineering at Duke Pratt School of Engineering, and worked his way into Miguel Nicolelis’ brain-computer interface lab, interests that inform his work to this day.

He originally co-founded Transcriptic, a robotic cloud laboratory for the life sciences. But most famously, he co-founded Neuralink in 2016 and served as its initial president, helping build the company that put brain implants into the public imagination. Then in 2021, he founded Science Corporation to develop advanced neural engineering and brain-computer interface technology. The company has a particular focus on applications to aid those in need of help with vision, cognition, and mobility.

And it’s not all speculation: Science Corp’s PRIMA implant has already restored eyesight in people with severe vision loss, using a pair of glasses with a tiny camera that beams a captured scene onto a chip implanted in the retina. Since its founding, it’s raised $230 million in a Series C round at a $1.5 billion valuation, and the company’s ambitions go beyond interfaces. Hodak sees additional applications of Science Corp’s brain-implanted sensors helping heal damaged brain cells, warning about seizures, and maybe even helping treat conditions as severe as Parkinson’s disease.

This is your best chance to learn how Hodak thinks the interface between people and machines is about to change, and the many ways that could impact your startup, your role, and maybe your life.

在Disrupt舞台举行的“超越屏幕”专场中，霍达克将阐述这样一个观点：科技的下一个时代可能建立在一种不同类型的界面之上——这种界面能够从脑机交互出发适应人类，为我们与机器互动创造新的方式。

Disrupt将于10月13日至15日重返旧金山莫斯科尼西馆，届时将汇聚来自创业公司、投资界和初创企业社区的1万多名参与者，并举办超过250场活动。今年，我们尤其关注如何打造可持续发展的人工智能公司，围绕人工智能展开的议程将覆盖六个行业舞台。

立即购买Disrupt门票，最多可节省200美元，并聆听这位硅谷最具雄心的创始人之一探索后屏幕时代的未来。

霍达克的职业经历仿佛一直在证明：人与机器之间的界面仍有很大的改进空间。他6岁开始编程，随后在杜克大学普拉特工程学院学习生物医学工程，并进入米格尔·尼科莱利斯的脑机接口实验室工作；这些经历时至今日仍在影响着他的工作。

他最初共同创办了Transcriptic，这是一家服务于生命科学领域的机器人云实验室。但最为人所知的是，他于2016年共同创办了Neuralink，并担任该公司的首任总裁，帮助建立了这家将脑植入物带入公众视野的公司。随后，他于2021年创办Science Corporation，致力于开发先进的神经工程和脑机接口技术。该公司尤其关注帮助视力、认知和行动能力受损人士的应用。

而这并不只是推测：Science Corp的PRIMA植入物已经帮助严重视力丧失者恢复视力。该系统使用一副配有微型摄像头的眼镜，将捕捉到的场景投射到植入视网膜的芯片上。自成立以来，公司已在C轮融资中筹集2.3亿美元，当时估值为15亿美元；而公司的雄心并不局限于界面。霍达克认为，Science Corp植入大脑的传感器还可用于帮助修复受损脑细胞、发出癫痫发作警告，甚至可能协助治疗帕金森病等严重疾病。

这是了解霍达克如何看待人与机器之间的界面即将发生改变，以及这种变化可能如何影响你的初创公司、你的职位，甚至你人生的最佳机会。

aiStories.fullContent:
Samus is geared up for another adventure. | Image: Nintendo

The Metroid series is going back to its 2D roots again with Metroid Ravenous for the Nintendo Switch 2, the first side-scrolling game in the series since 2021’s Metroid Dread for the Nintendo Switch. If you’re already excited enough to consider preordering, you can save $10 on the physical version of the game when you buy it from Walmart. It’s $59.88 instead of $69.99, about the same as buying it digitally. The game launches on January 28th, 2027, but it’s not clear how long the preorder discount will last. If it’s anything like other Walmart preorders , it may occasionally disappear.

$69.99 $59.88 at Walmart

Nintendo first showed off the side-scrolling adventure game at its September 2026 Direct , with a frantic trailer cutting between cinematic sequences, Samus dashing and rolling across a variety of environments, and engaging a number of enemies and bosses in battle. Samus absorbs some powerful abilities at the conclusion of Dread , and Ravenous seem to be all about plowing through anyone stopping her from escaping the planet. Other details of the story, including unique new mechanics, are being kept under wraps for the time being.

If you haven’t played Metroid Dread , I recommend it, especially at its $41.99 discounted price at Amazon . It’s part of Nintendo’s “Customer Appreciation” sale happening through September 26th, and several other games and accessories are cheaper, too.

aiStories.title: GitHub在计数方面遇到了问题
aiStories.originalTitle: GitHub is having trouble counting things
aiStories.fullContent:
In the past week, I’ve noticed two pretty severe UI bugs in GitHub. The first is an overcounting of PRs in the tab on a repository, this is particularly common after you merge a PR, but it’s not the only trigger of this behavior. To add insult to injury, the right count is even right there on this page.

The second occurred while I was trying to set up Sentry. I’ve been using GitHub for 11 years now, so I have collected three pages of org memberships. Unfortunately for me, the project I’m setting up Sentry for is on the second page.

For some reason, Chrome doesn’t let you modify the address in the bar for these pop-up windows. Luckily, you can force navigate using JavaScript.

Really curious as to what’s going on over there, if you’ve got any insight let me know!
aiStories.fullTranslation:
过去一周，我注意到 GitHub 中存在两个相当严重的界面漏洞。第一个是仓库标签页中对 PR 数量的重复计算，这种情况在合并 PR 后尤其常见，但这并不是触发该行为的唯一原因。更糟的是，正确的数量其实就在这个页面上。

第二个问题发生在我尝试设置 Sentry 时。我使用 GitHub 已经 11 年了，因此积累了整整三页组织成员资格。对我来说不幸的是，我要为其设置 Sentry 的项目位于第二页。

出于某种原因，Chrome 不允许你修改这些弹出窗口地址栏中的地址。幸运的是，你可以使用 JavaScript 强制跳转。

我真的很好奇那边到底发生了什么；如果你有什么见解，请告诉我！

aiStories.title: 你的人工智能代理现在可以控制 Google Home 设备
aiStories.originalTitle: Your AI agents can now control your Google Home devices
aiStories.snippet: Google is launching early access to a new MCP server for Google Home, allowing AI agents like Claude, ChatGPT, and others to control connected devices, review camera summaries, and access smart home activity using natural language.
aiStories.fullContent:
Smart home owners will soon be able to control their devices connected to Google Home via an AI agent. On Wednesday, Google rolled out early access to its Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for its Google Home ecosystem, which will allow any AI agent that supports MCP — like Claude, Hermes, OpenClaw, ChatGPT, and Google Antigravity — to securely work with their smart home devices and access their event history.

This update will allow people to use natural language instructions to do things like review their camera summaries, monitor smart home activity, control their connected devices, and build their own custom smart home dashboards.

To get the connection set up, users will need to create a Google Cloud project and configure it to use Home MCP. They will then provide the MCP configuration details to their agent of choice and ask it to set it up. The agent will then ask them to sign in and grant permissions. (A setup guide will also be offered in the Google Home Developer Center.)

The system will support any device in the Google Home ecosystem, including Google Nest doorbells and thermostats and “Works with Google Home” (or Matter) devices, like light bulbs.

Google already supports MCP in other areas of its business, including in its Google Cloud and data platforms, developer tools, and Google Workspace, for instance. Support for Google Home is targeted more directly at consumers who are experimenting with AI agents designed to handle everyday tasks.

Google wouldn’t comment on if or when the MCP would roll out more broadly, such as to other subscription tiers or markets.

Google is also soliciting feedback from early adopters during this period by way of its Smart Home for Developers Community, it says.

An earlier version of this post misstated the rollout’s start. It is today, Wednesday, not Tuesday.

trendStories.title: 索尼初代 PlayStation 2 的安全芯片在问世 26 年后被“彻底攻破”
trendStories.originalTitle: Original Sony PlayStation 2 security chip ‘broken wide open’ after 26 years
trendStories.fullContent:
Breakthrough will improve hardware preservation, repair, and emulation projects.

When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

The ‘magic security chip’ inside the original PlayStation 2 has been successfully reverse-engineered and dumped. Canadian retro hardware and software enthusiast DiscoStarslayer was the manic mind behind the cracking open of the CXP102064 MechaCon chip, which arrived inside the ‘PS2 Fat’ from 1999. It took “four years of effort” to reach this stage, but this milestone should be a boon to hardware preservation, repair, and emulation projects.

After 4 years of effort, I'm happy to announce that one of the final secrets of the PS2 has been broken wide open!It's been a long process of decapping, optical dumping, and now at last a software solution.Thank you Libby for finding the exploit from our dirty optical dumps! pic.twitter.com/VrsCH8I35CSeptember 13, 2026

The Mechacon got its name from its primary duty of controlling the PS2’s optical and flash drive mechanics. It also played a significant part in Sony’s game optical disc security, supporting “Magic Gate [memory card] and KELF file [executable] decryption among other things,” notes the PSDev Wiki. Unlocking the secret workings of such chips can be important to those involved in video game preservation. So, many people will appreciate DiscoStarslayer’s work in reverse engineering and dumping one of the PS2’s last remaining secrets.

As per the social media post, the arduous task of breaking the MechaCon’s security took four years. Some of the reverse engineering tricks utilized by DiscoStarslayer include chemically decapping the CXP102064 to expose the die, then using microscopes and optical dumping skills to analyze the silicon chip circuitry. In this case, a lucky break during the hacking apparently uncovered an exploit that provided a method whereby the chip’s data could be extracted through software.

With this achievement unlocked, the game/hardware preservation and programming communities can look forward to improved emulation and homebrew developments. It should also open up possibilities for replacing the aging optical drives in PS2 consoles.

Beyond the confines of PS2 Fat consoles, some social media commenters noted that the MechaCon was also used in a handful of arcade machines from the era. Specifically, the Namco System 246 and System 256, as well as the Konami Python 1, which used modified PS2 hardware, used the MechaCon firmware to authenticate security and allow the execution of encrypted game data.

trendStories.title: “铁蛋白脸”：席卷社交媒体的新健康恐慌
trendStories.originalTitle: Ferritin face: the new health scare taking social media by storm
trendStories.source: The Guardian Society (卫报社会与民生)
trendStories.snippet: Seeing a pallid, washed-out face in the mirror? Prepare to be diagnosed … Name: Ferritin face. Age: The name is new, but the symptoms are old. Continue reading...
trendStories.fullContent:
Seeing a pallid, washed-out face in the mirror? Prepare to be diagnosed …

Name: Ferritin face.

Age: The name is new, but the symptoms are old.

Symptoms: Pallor, dull skin, dark circles under your eyes. Looking washed out, basically.

What are you, a mirror? Oh no, does this describe you? Do you also have ferritin face?

Aren’t those just symptoms for “looking tired”? Is this one of those social media health scares with little to no scientific basis? No! I mean, yes, the term has recently become very popular on social media, as reported in the Washington Post. Ferritin face is not a real medical term (nor are there consistent criteria that define it) – but ferritin at least is definitely a thing.

Tell me about ferritin, then. It’s a complex globular protein that stores iron in the body in its inactive form. If you have low ferritin levels, it could indicate an iron deficiency.

And what happens if I have an iron deficiency? If it is severe and goes untreated for long enough, it could lead to tachycardia, breathlessness, chest pain and heart complications.

This is terrible! How can I cure myself? Well, earlier this summer, Allure magazine wrote a long piece entitled What It Means to Have “Ferritin Face”, calling iron deficiency an epidemic that women are prone to. It had plenty of advice.

Like what? Tell me now, before my dark circles kill me! It can often be overcome with a change of diet, as meat and green leafy vegetables are a good source. But you can also just go and have an intravenous iron infusion.

An IV it is! Be warned that, according to a leading iron infusion clinic, it could cost you in the region of £800.

Cabbage! Someone get me a cabbage! Alternatively, you could stop crapping your pants at every social media health scare. You should never diagnose and treat yourself via TikTok clips.

OK, fine. Think it about it sensibly. There is a vast difference between ferritin face and actual anaemia. Anaemia doesn’t just make you pale and tired-looking; it can leave you fatigued and breathless, with headaches, dizziness, palpitations and a loss of concentration being common symptoms.

Oh, I don’t have any of those. Good. But if you do, the NHS recommends that you see a GP, who will try to discover the underlying reason for your iron deficiency – which could be anything from heavy periods to cancer – and put you on a course of iron tablets.

So I don’t need to worry about ferritin. Probably not, no. But get an early night tonight. You look dreadful.

Do say: “You do not have ferritin face.”

Don’t say: “But you do have ferreting face, which is far worse.”
trendStories.fullTranslation:
在镜子里看到一张苍白、毫无血色的脸？准备好接受诊断吧……

名称：铁蛋白脸。

年龄：这个名称是新出现的，但症状却由来已久。

症状：脸色苍白、皮肤暗淡、眼下有黑眼圈。基本上就是看起来面色憔悴、毫无血色。

你这是镜子吗？哦，不，这说的不就是你吗？难道你也有铁蛋白脸？

这些不就是“看起来很疲惫”的症状吗？这是不是又一种几乎没有科学依据的社交媒体健康恐慌？不！我的意思是，是的，这个词最近在社交媒体上大为流行，《华盛顿邮报》对此也有报道。铁蛋白脸并不是一个真正的医学术语（也没有界定它的一套统一标准）——但至少，铁蛋白确实是实实在在存在的东西。

那就跟我说说铁蛋白吧。铁蛋白是一种复杂的球状蛋白质，以非活性形式储存人体内的铁。如果铁蛋白水平偏低，可能意味着缺铁。

如果我缺铁，会发生什么？如果缺铁严重，而且长期得不到治疗，可能导致心动过速、呼吸困难、胸痛以及心脏并发症。

太可怕了！我该怎么治好自己？今年初夏，《魅力》杂志刊登了一篇题为《拥有“铁蛋白脸”意味着什么》的长篇文章，称缺铁是女性容易受到影响的一种流行病。文章给出了大量建议。

比如呢？趁我的黑眼圈还没要了我的命，赶紧告诉我！通常可以通过改变饮食来改善，因为肉类以及绿叶蔬菜都是铁的良好来源。不过，你也可以直接去接受静脉输铁。

那就打点滴吧！但要注意，据一家知名输铁诊所介绍，这可能要花费约800英镑。

卷心菜！快给我找一棵卷心菜来！或者，你也可以别再因为社交媒体上的每一次健康恐慌而吓得屁滚尿流。你绝不应该通过TikTok短视频给自己下诊断、治病。

好吧，知道了。理性地想一想。铁蛋白脸和真正的贫血之间存在天壤之别。贫血不只是让你脸色苍白、看起来疲惫；它还会让你感到乏力、呼吸困难，头痛、头晕、心悸以及注意力不集中也都是常见症状。

哦，这些症状我一个都没有。那就好。但如果你有这些症状，英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）建议你去看全科医生。医生会设法找出你缺铁的根本原因——可能是月经过多，也可能是癌症——并让你接受一段时间的铁片治疗。

所以我不用担心铁蛋白了。大概不用，是的。不过今晚早点睡。你看起来糟透了。

可以说：“你没有铁蛋白脸。”

不要说：“但你有一张翻箱倒柜脸，那糟糕得多。”
